<thought>Based on the monoisotopic peak at m/z 127.0997 and the isotopic pattern (≈8 % M+1, very low M+2), the molecule likely contains about eight carbons and no heavy heteroatoms (no Cl, Br, S). The best matching elemental composition is C₈H₁₅O, whose calculated monoisotopic mass (127.112 Da) is within typical experimental error of the observed 127.0997 Da.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H15O</final_answer>
